about.title: Rio Dell Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Rio Dell is a small town, a little over 3,300 people in Humboldt County, and when someone here dies because of another person's carelessness, the loss is felt on nearly every street. Public records for 2025 show one injury collision inside city limits and no traffic deaths, which is worth saying plainly: fatal crashes are not common here. But wrongful death cases come from many places besides the road. A fall at a job site, a medication error, a defective product, or a collision on US-101 southbound or across the SR-283 Eagle Prairie Bridge can each leave a family with questions that no one is answering. California law lets certain relatives bring a civil claim for those losses, and that claim runs on its own clock, separate from any criminal investigation. LawProactive exists to make the next step simple. Tell us what happened, and we connect you, free of charge, with an independent attorney who handles wrongful death matters in Humboldt County. You speak with them directly, and they work on contingency.

items.title: Clarity on who can file
items.desc: California limits wrongful death claims to a spouse or domestic partner and children first, then certain dependents and heirs. An attorney in our network can tell you quickly where your family stands.

items.title: The deadline is real
items.desc: Most claims must be filed within two years of the date of death, and the window is shorter when a government entity may be responsible. Connecting early protects that time.

items.title: Losses that count
items.desc: Recoverable losses include funeral and burial costs, the financial support your loved one would have provided, and the loss of their love, companionship, and guidance. No fee is owed unless there is a recovery.

items.question: The crash happened on US-101 near Rio Dell. Does that change anything?
items.answer: It might. US-101 and the SR-283 Eagle Prairie Bridge are state-maintained, so if a road condition or a public vehicle played a role, a government entity could be involved. Claims against government entities in California carry a much shorter deadline than the standard two years, which is one reason to speak with an attorney sooner rather than later.

items.question: Is a wrongful death claim the same as the criminal case?
items.answer: No. A wrongful death claim is a civil action brought by the family, while a criminal case is brought by the district attorney. The two proceed separately, and a civil claim can move forward whether or not criminal charges are filed.

items.question: What does it cost to use LawProactive?
items.answer: Nothing. LawProactive is a free connection service, not a law firm. The independent attorney you're matched with works on contingency, meaning you pay no attorney fee unless your family recovers compensation.
